comment: Active/inactive/phospho species were mapped to their underlying proteins (ATM, ATR, TP53, HDAC4, etc.). PP2A is treated as the PP2A protein and its inhibitory complex PP2A_I2PP2A is represented as a complex composed of PP2A and I2PP2A (SET). Small molecules Omaveloxolone and spermidine were annotated as chemicals. DNA_damage and autophagy state species are abstract/process-level entities (annotated as unknown). NRF2_degraded was mapped to NRF2 (protein) as a degradation state of the same protein.
